main_text.p: hiqve tanta cum humanitate demon-stret, se boni consuluisse, imo gratias mi-hi habere, qvòd lætitiam de summi Pontificis benevolentia in illustrissimam familiam Barberinam rediviva animo meo exundantem per Epistolam meam affluere siverim, mihi profecto magna confidentia est, gratum & acceptum multo magis Eminentiæ tuæ fore, si illius commodis inservire qvomodo possem, & opera mea obsequium aliqvod illi præstare; qvapropter cum iisdem literis hujus rei occasionem mihi dederit, non lubens modo, sed alacer eam amplector.

Postulat à me[?] Eminentia tua sententiam meam de Ludovici Capelli Critica Sacra; qvanqvam E. V. sit literarum omnis generis ornamentis politissima, virisqve doctissimis undiqve circumdata, atqve in medio mundi sole constituta, tamen qvoniam jubet, lumen soli mutuum dabo, & facula mea meridiem illu-strabo; de sacra igitur Capelli Critica dicturus ut ordine procedat sermo noster, eum in tres partes dividam; primùm de

page.notes: The first word of the second paragraph is damaged and read as "me" with a [?]. The page number and running head are slightly smudged but legible. The last word "de" is the catchword, not part of the text. The text of the page continues onto the next page, so the final paragraph is not closed here.
